title: About Bracket Bear
subtitle: Creative Technology Partner
metaDescription: Learn about Bracket Bear's story, philosophy, and values. Founded by Harrison Callahan to bring hospitality to experience agencies.

hero.title: About Bracket Bear
hero.subtitle: We believe experience agencies deserve to be treated with the same care they give their audiences.

ourStory.title: Our Story
ourStory.content:
Bracket Bear was founded by Harrison Callahan after more than a decade building interactive installations, brand experiences, and creative tools for award-winning studios like Downstream and Deeplocal.
He saw a simple truth: the people crafting wonder for others rarely receive that same hospitality themselves.
So he built a new kind of partner — one that leads with care, listens deeply, and helps experiential agencies do their best work in the world.

philosophy.title: Our Philosophy: The Magic Wand Method
philosophy.subtitle: Every collaboration begins with a question:
philosophy.content:
"If you could wave a magic wand and fix one thing keeping your agency from reaching its potential, what would it be?"

That question unlocks our work.
It invites curiosity, honesty, and a shared vision of what better looks like.
Sometimes the answer is a process bottleneck. Sometimes it's technical uncertainty.
Whatever it is, we design around it — removing friction so creativity can flow.

coreValues.title: Our Core Values: The Three C's
coreValues.subtitle: The principles that guide everything we do:

values.title: Community
values.description: Bracket Bear was founded to be a platform for greater good. We use it to elevate our local communities, social causes, and the experiential tech industry as a whole.

values.title: Collaboration
values.description: We believe the sum of our collective ideas is greater than its parts. We build strong partnerships and do everything we can to help them succeed.

values.title: Consistency
values.description: We sweat the details. When you choose Bracket Bear, you get quality craft paired with clear, thoughtful communication every time.

whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.content:
We're artists who code, engineers who care, and partners who lead with hospitality.
Our team brings the same curiosity and precision to every project — whether we're guiding a pitch, building a prototype, or installing an interactive space.
Because care and craft belong in every step.

contactCTA.text: Let's bring some hospitality to your next experience.
